response.rationale: Both answers accurately express the intended sense. “Tim” is a standard Indonesian term for a group or team, while Malaysian Malay “pasukan” denotes a group/team, including task teams. The relation is a reasonable preference contrast, not an absolute exclusivity claim. No false-friend issue is present.
